labels.label: risk
labels.reason: EXPLAIN output now shows pg_temp instead of the actual temp schema name, which could break tools or tests that parse EXPLAIN output.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: pg_statio_all_tables now returns a single summed row for TOAST tables with multiple indexes instead of one row per index, changing results for queries that depend on it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Pre-existing custom variables matching an extension name are deleted on extension load and new ones are blocked, which can break configurations relying on them.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The stats_temp_directory server variable is removed, so configs that set it will need to be changed.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: random() now yields different results even for the same seed, which could break applications depending on reproducible sequences.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: PQsendQuery() is no longer supported in pipeline mode, so applications must be modified to use PQsendQueryParams().

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Home directory lookup now consults HOME first on non-Windows, which can change where libpq and clients find files like ~/.pgpass.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The pg_dump --no-synchronized-snapshots option is removed, so scripts using it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: psql --single-transaction now rolls back after an error only if ON_ERROR_STOP is set, changing commit/rollback behavior for scripts.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: postgres_fdw no longer casts constants unnecessarily, which changes the queries sent to remote servers and could alter behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: xml2's xml_is_well_formed() function is removed, so callers must switch to the core backend implementation.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Custom scan providers are now assumed not to support projections by default, so providers that do must be updated.
